import asyncio,json,os,sys
from mcp import ClientSession,StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client
ws,hbin=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
lines=['2026-09-25T10:%02d:%02dZ request=%d status=200 path=/api/items latency_ms=%d' % (i//60,i%60,i,20+i%7) for i in range(600)]
lines[313]='2026-09-25T10:05:13Z request=313 status=503 path=/api/items latency_ms=30000 CRITICAL upstream timeout nsr-anomaly-7f3a'
content='\n'.join(lines)
env={'HOME':os.environ['HOME'],'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR':ws,'HEADROOM_OFFLINE':'1','HEADROOM_TELEMETRY':'off','HEADROOM_BEACON':'off','DO_NOT_TRACK':'1'}
def text(r): return ''.join(getattr(x,'text','') for x in r.content)
async def main():
    async with stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command=hbin,args=['mcp','serve','--proxy-url','http://127.0.0.1:1'],env=env)) as (r,w):
        async with ClientSession(r,w) as s:
            await s.initialize()
            tools=sorted(t.name for t in (await s.list_tools()).tools)
            c=json.loads(text(await s.call_tool('headroom_compress',{'content':content})))
            o=json.loads(text(await s.call_tool('headroom_retrieve',{'hash':c['hash']})))
            b=json.loads(text(await s.call_tool('headroom_retrieve',{'hash':'0123456789abcdef01234567'})))
            st=json.loads(text(await s.call_tool('headroom_stats',{})))
            exact=o.get('original_content')==content
            print('tools',tools,'| compress',c['original_tokens'],'->',c['compressed_tokens'],'tokens',c.get('transforms'),'| retrieve by hash byte-identical:',exact,'| unknown hash:',b.get('error','')[:45],'| stats compressions',st.get('compressions'))
            return tools==['headroom_compress','headroom_retrieve','headroom_stats'] and c['compressed_tokens']<c['original_tokens'] and exact and 'nsr-anomaly-7f3a' in o['original_content'] and 'Content not found' in b.get('error','') and st.get('compressions')==1
raise SystemExit(0 if asyncio.run(main()) else 1)
" "$W/workspace" "$H" || exit 1; s1=$(stat -c '%n %Y %s' "$HOME/.headroom/savings_events.jsonl" "$HOME/.headroom/session_stats.jsonl" "$HOME/.headroom/ccr_store.db" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '); test "$s0" = "$s1" && echo "global ~/.headroom ledger and store files unchanged (state went to the owned workspace: $(ls "$W/workspace" | tr '\n' ' '))"
